title: Desperately Seeking An Anchor
text:
Desperately Seeking An Anchor

Charles Gave, Louis-Vincent Gave

Gavekal Research | 14 Sep 2026

Charles and Louis argue that a new monetary anchor is emerging in Asia, centered on the renminbi, just as Western currencies and bond markets are becoming less reliable stores of value. With most of the world’s excess savings generated in Asia, more capital will stay in the region rather than flow into Western assets, eroding structural support for the US dollar, euro and Western bond markets. In this chart book, they show how this emerging China-centered monetary order represents a profound shift in global finance that Western investors have yet to price in.
